title: PICEE-PA: Cryptographic Governance, Immutable Audit Trails and Administrative Imputation for AI Agents in Public Administration (v1.3.0)
description: PICEE-PA (Policy, Identity, Capability, Execution, Evidence) is a vendor-neutral governance framework and application profile connecting administrative authorization (L. 241/1990, CAD Artt. 20-21, L. 132/2025, Consiglio di Stato n. 8472/2019) to technical authorization for AI-initiated actions in Public Administration. Features fail-closed policy enforcement, delegation attenuation, tamper-evident append-only hash chains, and AgID ModI / PDND interoperability envelopes.
